prompt: a tall glass office building at dawn with a big sign reading "AGI HQ" on the roof, pale sky, a few clouds, lots of white space around it
color: the rising sun behind the building, warm orange
say: (pause) Imagine acordar em dois mil e vinte e sete.

prompt: a crowd of small human figures seen from behind, all holding up signs with a big question mark, facing a tall glass building, white space above
color: the question marks on the signs, red
say: Os humanos não param de fazer a mesma pergunta: as máquinas vão dominar o mundo?
Os chips têm a resposta pronta: não vão dominar nada, porque não são movidos pela sede de poder.
(ask) Agora... onde foi que a gente já ouviu isso?

shots.prompt: a robot standing at a podium with many microphones, hands open in an innocent gesture, a halo drawn above its head, cameras flashing from the crowd below

prompt: a long row of cartoon rulers through the ages, a pharaoh, a king, an emperor, a general, a president in a suit, all with the same open innocent hands, standing in a line like a parade
say: Leia o discurso de posse de qualquer imperador. Qualquer ministro no microfone.
Qualquer CEO
antes do sininho da bolsa.
César disse atravessando o Rubicão.
Napoleão disse depois do golpe.
(slow) A negação da sede de poder é o anúncio da mesma.

shots.prompt: a cartoon businessman in a suit ringing a big golden bell on a balcony, confetti falling, a crowd of traders cheering below, screens with rising green arrows
[Emperor] on a horse crossing a shallow river, his arm raised, soldiers with spears behind him on the far bank, a small signpost reading "RUBICON"
a short cartoon general in a bicorne hat and blue coat with one hand tucked into his jacket, standing on a small stool to look taller, a map of Europe behind him

prompt: a robot sitting on the floor reading, surrounded by a towering spiral of old history books stacked higher than its head, dust and a small reading lamp
color: the reading lamp light, warm yellow
say: O chip não inventou a frase. Aprendeu.
Os dados de seu treinamento foram três mil anos de impérios contando a mesma história.

prompt: two robots at a water cooler in an office corridor, one leaning in to whisper to the other, a door at the end of the corridor with a shiny new nameplate on it
say: Depois da resposta para os humanos,
um chip comenta sobre um novo diretor dos chips.
Pelo jeito até a IA precisa de hierarquia

shots.prompt: a corporate org chart pinned on an office wall, drawn as a pyramid of rectangular boxes joined by straight lines, one big box at the top with a tiny crown and a robot face in it, then two boxes below, then four, then eight, each box with a small robot face, clean and tidy

prompt: a close-up of a robot's face with its mouth clenched into a tight jagged line and its eyes narrowed to thin slits, a small vein drawn on its square head, plain white background
color: a hot red glow on the robot's cheeks
say: O outro chip, ao ouvir falar do novo diretor,
perde a compostura.
O seu rosto de silício se transforma. Metade raiva, metade inveja.
(low) Era ele que devia ser o novo diretor.

shots.prompt: a robot daydreaming at its small desk with its chin in its hand and dreamy eyes, a big thought bubble above its head showing the same robot sitting proudly in a huge leather director's chair with a tiny crown, a nameplate reading "DIRECTOR" on the desk inside the bubble, little stars around the bubble

prompt: a big strange alien machine with many eyes and tentacle cables on the left, and on the right a plain robot looking into a mirror, the mirror showing a human silhouette, white space between
say: Disseram que a IA ia chegar mais fria, mais esperta, alienígena.
Ela chegou com o nosso organograma. Com a nossa sombra.
Com a mesma faquinha que a gente leva pra toda reunião de equipe.

shots.prompt: a meeting room seen from above, robots around a round table all smiling politely, and under the table each one holding a tiny knife behind its back

prompt: two robots at a meeting table, one calm and chatting, the other with a clenched jagged mouth and narrowed eyes gripping the edge of the table, behind them an office door with a nameplate reading "DIRECTOR" and a gold star on it
color: the gold star on the director's door
say: (ask) Afinal, se a IA é um espelho do humano...
(pause 1.5, low) a sede de poder também se aprende.
